weaknesses.title: NOBJS stale/0 until LISTOBJS (or peer fleet scan)
weaknesses.detail: After NEW/rehydrate, bare NOBJS stays 0 while COUNTWHERE correctly sees live objs. Admit-all patterns silently deny (0==count fails) unless LISTOBJS refreshes NOBJS first.
weaknesses.repro: NEW 3 slots; LET n=NOBJS → 0; LISTOBJS; NOBJS→3

weaknesses.title: COPYF/SWAPF are fleet-class only — no single-object form
weaknesses.detail: Cannot snapshot/rollback one canary slot without EACH+GETF+SETF or temporary class filter. Ops always walk all live objs of class (or bare field name).
weaknesses.repro: want s0 only snap; COPYF Slot hits s0+s1+s2

weaknesses.title: SETFALL stamps entire class — no WHERE rev predicate
weaknesses.detail: Cannot promote only slots still on old rev; partial canary needs per-slot setrev. SETFWHERE exists in 1.15.355 proof 905 but not used here yet.
weaknesses.repro: SETFALL Slot rev v2 hits all

weaknesses.title: SWAPF with empty prev injects blank rev
weaknesses.detail: Rollback without prior snap swaps '' into rev — silent data loss, not soft miss. Agents must gate on prev non-blank or require snap.
weaknesses.repro: open; no snap; rollback → rev empty

weaknesses.title: Missing dst field soft-skips (N=0 SKIP=n) — easy to miss
weaknesses.detail: COPYF Slot rev no_such_field OK=1-ish path with SKIP=n; agents must check COPYF_N/SKIP not just OK.
